Ao longo de seu dorso, há padrões intricados que se assemelham a runas antigas, carregadas com a maldição de seu criador. mxkUUfU5PYo793JRW7u4.description:
More noticeably than any other Nobody, **Samurai** seem to adhere to ideology. They approach fighting much the way an honorable duelist would, playing by a strict set of rules.

**Samurai** sit patiently--literally resting cross-legged on the ground--through battles, apparently contemplating the chaos around them. They take action only when they or their allies are threatened, or when they deem a particular opponent worthy to face them in single combat. When it has selected an adversary, a **Samurai** will stand up and stride toward its foe, activating its *Ikki-Uchi* feature.

In a way, due to their familiar approach to combat and recognizably humanoid behavior, **Samurai** are the easiest Nobody to strategize against. At this point, more is understood about **Samurai** behavior and motivations than any other Nobody. But what makes these Nobodies so much more like us?


*Original art by Tetsuya Nomura.*

nPbpvKFtNfOfz8aQrs4E.description:
The silent and mysterious **Sorcerers** are the only Nobodies yet discovered that rely primarily on spellcasting, rather than physical combat. This distinction makes them a unique threat.

It is rare for more than one **Sorcerer** to appear at once, but they are almost always encountered alongside other Nobodies. **Sorcerers** float high above the battlefield, observing the situation and using their magical abilities to hinder foes and help allies. They will never enter melee range willingly. At the start of combat, a **Sorcerer** will usually identify key allies and shield them with its *Void Barrier*. Then it will single out the most dangerous enemy and decimate them with *Ruin* whenever possible. When its magical reserves are depleted, the **Sorcerer** will siphon mana from a target with its *Empty Melodies*. If endangered, a **Sorcerer** will immediately recall one or more *Void Cubes*, to maximize its offensive options.

**Sorcerers** are known to pick their targets wisely, as if they can evaluate their enemies' strengths and weaknesses.


*Original art by Tetsuya Nomura.*
